name: Minnesota
sources: MN DOR press release 2025-12-16 and 'Inflation Adjusted Amounts, Tax Year 2026' (revenue.state.mn.us/sites/default/files/2025-12/inflation-adjusted-amounts-2026.pdf): brackets, standard deduction, aged/blind add-on, deduction-limitation thresholds, dependent exemption and its phaseout thresholds
Minn. Stat. 290.0123 subd. 5 (standard deduction reduced by 3% of AGI between the two thresholds plus 10% above the second, at most 80%)
Minn. Stat. 290.0121 subd. 2 (dependent exemption reduced 2% per $2,500 of AGI over the threshold, $1,250 if married filing separately)
Minn. Stat. 290.0122 (itemized deductions: medical above 10% of AGI, real and personal property tax capped at $10,000 / $5,000 MFS, mortgage interest, charitable gifts)
Minn. Stat. 290.033 (1% tax on net investment income over $1,000,000, not indexed)
notes: Minnesota also cuts itemized deductions (other than medical) for incomes above about $244,000; that cut is not applied here, so estimates for high earners who itemize may be low.
Refundable credits (child and working family credits) are not included.

surtax.label: Net investment income tax (1% over $1 million)
